sources.source_name: Major investment to drive economic development in North Belfast
sources.license: Northern Ireland public-sector website terms/Crown copyright apply; factual metadata and URLs retained for audit.
sources.geographic_scope: North Belfast: York Street, Duncairn Gardens and Edlingham Street properties
sources.granularity: Named properties and public investment/acquisition milestone
sources.key_fields: Date published, investment amount, acquiring/beneficiary body, three property names/addresses, intended future use, funding source.
sources.reliability: strong for public investment/acquisition announcement; usable with caveats for future built-environment transformation.
sources.required_caveats: Do not treat as planning permission, refurbishment start, completion, opening, occupancy, job creation, or measured economic outcome. Exact property boundaries are not provided.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Accept as a pre-development/acquisition candidate if the atlas includes public estate/property acquisition milestones; follow with later planning, contract, works-start and opening records if published.

sources.license: Belfast City Council public committee-document terms; factual planning metadata and source URLs retained for audit.
sources.granularity: Planning application report, proposal, site description, recommendation and draft condition
sources.key_fields: Application ID, committee meeting date, proposal, location, recommendation, applicant, agent, consultees, draft conditions.
sources.reliability: usable with caveats for recommendation-stage planning event.
sources.required_caveats: Agenda/officer report is not a final decision notice. It does not confirm construction, operation, visitor numbers, permanent use, or event outcomes.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Accept as a planning-recommendation candidate with explicit stage label; upgrade or supersede when minutes/decision notice are available.

sources.reliability: strong for agenda/report existence; caveated for final decision status.

sources.license: Belfast City Council terms; factual live-list metadata and source URLs retained for audit.
sources.geographic_scope: Belfast City Council planning authority area
sources.granularity: Application reference, location, proposal and advertisement date
sources.key_fields: Advertised date, application reference, address/location, proposal text.
sources.reliability: usable with caveats for application-advertisement discovery; weak as a durable source because the page is mutable.
sources.required_caveats: Use Planning Portal records, committee reports or decision notices for durable application status. Live advertisement rows are not approvals or construction evidence.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: No new Round368 candidate emitted directly from this source because May 2026 major rows were already represented in the manual corpus/prior packs or were too minor/live-list-only.

sources.source_name: Changes to the List of Buildings of special architectural or historic interest
sources.publisher: Department for Communities Historic Environment Division
sources.license: Crown copyright / Department for Communities terms; factual publication metadata retained for audit.
sources.coverage_years: Publication page last updated 2026-04-03; March 2026 record-only records visible
sources.update_frequency: Updated when HED publishes list-change material
sources.geographic_scope: Northern Ireland, with Belfast rows screened by HB/site name
sources.key_fields: Publication update date, HED record type, structure name, HB reference where available.
sources.reliability: strong for HED publication status; caveated where rows are record-only or proposed consultation status.

sources.ingestion_recommendation: No new Round368 candidate; recent Belfast HED/listing rows were already emitted or rejected by Round113/310/353/357/361.

sources.source_name: Queen's, Ulster/Stranmillis and public campus project pages/news
sources.publisher: Queen's University Belfast; Department for the Economy; Ulster public museum/campus pages
sources.license: Publisher-specific website terms; factual metadata and URLs only.
sources.coverage_years: Recent 2026 official/public campus news pages checked
sources.key_fields: Publication date, project/site name, milestone wording, location/address, project status.
sources.reliability: strong where a dated official page states a construction/opening milestone; mutable pages require caveats.
sources.required_caveats: Do not ingest future opening/occupation, awards, or design claims as physical completion without dated observed source evidence.
